A '''HoloNet relay station''' orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. It was the primary [[Relay station/Legends|relay station]] for the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]], and was guarded by a defense platform.<ref name="CatCW" />
